text: Cause: Stain from contamination from handling, dye or dirt has marked the fabric near the lower left. Action: Find the source, clean the handling points, and isolate the stained section.
Cause: Worn or over-tight needles are causing needle marks on the fabric. Action: Inspect the needle condition and fabric tension, and replace the worn needles to prevent further needle marks.
Cause: A machine restart or adjustment has left setup marks on the fabric near the lower left. Action: Review recent machine stops and settings, and mark the affected section.
Cause: Worn or over-tight needles are causing needle marks on the fabric. Action: Inspect the needle condition and fabric tension, and replace the worn needles to prevent further damage.
Cause: Stain marks on the fabric are due to contamination from handling, dye or dirt. Action: Find the source, clean the handling points, and isolate the stained section.
Cause: Yarn breakage, snagging or needle damage has torn the fabric near the selvedge. Action: Mark the section, cut it out, and inspect the yarn path and needles for damage.

Cause: Yarn dust, specifically lint or fibre dust, has settled on the fabric near the centre. Action: Clean the machine and surrounding area, and check the airflow and take-up area to ensure proper fabric movement and prevent further accumulation of dust.
